text:
elaine wong: FYI I opened a docs PR to add Aegis2-13B to the model catalog. Covers supported deployment modes, sequence/response limits, internal perf numbers, and a short SDK v2 migration example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8201 :wave:
pranav shah: awesome. can you include estimated memory footprints (fp16 vs int8) and a quick note on batch sizing? customers hit OOMs when they assumed same footprint as our smaller models.
elaine wong: added a small "memory & sizing" subsection. TL;DR: FP16 ~30GB VRAM, int8/quant builds ~14-18GB (depends on tokenizer/seq). recommend batch_size <= 4 on 24GB cards for 2048 sequences.
joel kim: also include default sequence_limit (hosted) and what we allow on Dedicated. folks ask if 12k is supported.
elaine wong: added: "default hosted sequence ceiling: 8k tokens. Dedicated customers can request up to 12k with a tuned runtime profile (KV caching + higher mem instance)."
pranav shah: can we add a tiny perf snapshot for readers: A100-40GB at 2048 tokens vs 8192 tokens, and a CPU-quant reference (8 vCPU)? helps set expectations.
elaine wong: added internal perf numbers (approx): A100-40GB @2048 seq: 980 tok/s, A100-40GB @8192 seq: 290 tok/s, CPU-quant (8vCPU): 280 tok/s. marked as noisy/infra-dependent.
joel kim: nice. one more: SDK snippet in the PR still used the old client. swapping to SDK v2 streaming example would be useful. I can paste a suggested snippet.
pranav shah: here's a minimal streaming-safe example to use in the migration section:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
with client.generate_stream(model='aegis2-13b', input='Explain the deployment options', max_tokens=256) as stream:
    for chunk in stream:
        print(chunk.text, end='')
```
short, shows new API and works well with streaming UIs.
elaine wong: perfect — swapped that in. also added a short migration tip for Aurora7B -> Aegis2: reduce batch_size ~2x, enable prefix KV caching, and prefer int8 if VRAM constrained.
docs-bot: CI started for PR #8201 1 checks: markdown-lint, doc-build, link-check.
pranav shah: small nit: change header "benchmarks (internal)" to "internal perf numbers" to match other pages.
elaine wong: updated header. fixed a broken anchor that link-check flagged. command I ran locally: `yarn doc-check && npx markdown-link-check docs/models/aegis2-13b.md`
infra-bot: Verified perf run `bench-aegis2-20260318` for A100 numbers, values within noise. Tagged PR with `infra-verified`.
joel kim: LGTM from docs side after the snippet swap and header change.
pranav shah: LGTM too. can we add a "See also" link to /examples/aegis2-migration? customers prefer a notebook.
elaine wong: added a placeholder to "See also" and filed an examples issue to add the notebook: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/issues/240
docs-bot: All checks passed for PR #8201. Ready for review. :shipit:
elaine wong: merging now. thanks everyone!
joel kim: thanks — can you drop a short blurb for next week's release notes? I'll help edit.
elaine wong: will draft a 1-paragraph blurb and post in #announcements next week. :tada:
